title: Database generation
description: B1: the effective configuration of the database service, as generation.json in its own directory of the generations volume. The database adopts a new generation in place.

generation.description: The generation number. A higher number replaces a lower one.

status_url.description: Where the service reports its status to the control plane.

status_interval_s.description: How often the service reports its status, in seconds.

address.description: Where a service signs in to the database: its host and port on the install network, the database's name, and the role the service signs in as.
